summary: Avalanche caught six skiers on a Silverton Avalanche School field day in Senator Beck Basin; instructor took a serious ride, one student was fully buried and recovered unresponsive after ~50 min of digging by the other five.
location: Senator Beck Basin, near Red Mountain Pass
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team (agency assist to San Juan County); Helitrax helicopter
notes: OMRT paged 3:35 p.m. Jan 5 with 3 vehicles, 9 personnel; other 5 skiers descended. Body retrieval delayed by avalanche danger/nightfall; recovered Tuesday Jan 8 by Helitrax after explosive mitigation. Multi-agency coordination meeting followed. Outside Magazine retrospective (2022-02-28): victim named as Pete Marshall, 40, of Longmont, buried ~2.7 m (9 ft) deep, fully excavated ~50 min after the 2:41 PM slide; guide Zach Lovell, lead instructor Sandy Kobrock; St. Paul Lodge hutkeeper Tyler George (San Juan County SAR EMT) relayed the radio distress call to Sheriff Bruce Conrad; party left the scene by headlamp after CPR failed. Run 660: Durango Telegraph 'Turning point' (Oct-2019 Four Corners Snow & Avalanche Workshop feature) recounts Marshall's death — buried under both avalanches in the Jan-5 Silverton Avalanche School course near Red Mountain Pass (parent-opened).
